scope: post-V8 role-free graphics evidence from IRIS heads through Compiler, RSS and native reference runtime
authority_note: This is a source-lineage audit. It proves implemented consumption paths and cited behavioral tests, not teacher correctness or Fit8 scientific quality.

relation_truth_note.v8_fit8_shard_builder: relation_cut_probability uses (owner differs) OR (material id differs)
relation_truth_note.interpretation: V8 cut residual measures decodability of an owner-or-material boundary proxy, not authoritative drawable-cut truth
relation_truth_note.replacement: Graphics Truth V2 requires explicit authority/provenance/validity and can abstain

same_drawable_affinity.compiler_use: compiler/realsas_compiler_core/graphics_v1.py::compile_graphics_v1 uses thresholded same_drawable with cut/boundary/confidence to union adjacent canonical-M faces into fragments
same_drawable_affinity.runtime_materialization: face_fragment_index and fragment_ids in RuntimeGraphicsV1 -> graphics.bin
same_drawable_affinity.behavioral_path: fragment ownership changes visibility domain and explicit precedence domain used by native graphics runtime
limitations: historical Fit8 target uses anonymous source-object ownership as the same-drawable proxy
low V8 loss is decodability evidence, not proof of correct real-world drawable ownership

cut_probability.compiler_use: compile_graphics_v1 blocks fragment union when cut exceeds policy.cut_max
cut_probability.runtime_materialization: effect is compiled into fragment ownership rather than emitted as a raw runtime probability
limitations: the helper graphics_truth_v1 path uses cut=1-same, but the Fit8 builder used by V8 instead writes owner-difference OR material-difference
neither historical target is independently identified causal drawable-cut truth
new work must use explicit validity/provenance or abstain

alpha_boundary_probability.compiler_use: compile_graphics_v1 uses alpha boundary in fragment-union gate and derives support_band_pixels
alpha_boundary_probability.runtime_materialization: fragment ownership and support_band_pixels are serialized
alpha_boundary_probability.behavioral_path: fragment ownership is behaviorally consumed; support_band_pixels itself is not yet consumed by the native reference renderer
limitations: support-band transport must not be credited as behavior until an authorized runtime consumer exists

appearance_boundary_probability.compiler_use: compile_graphics_v1 uses appearance boundary in fragment-union gate
appearance_boundary_probability.behavioral_path: fragment ownership changes native visibility/order domain

front_probability.compiler_use: compile_graphics_v1 aggregates front probabilities into directed GraphicsOrderEdgeV1 edges
front_probability.behavioral_path: runtime/realsas_cpp/src/graphics_v1.hpp::order_pixel_layers gives explicit graph precedence priority over contradictory physical depth

occlusion_probability.compiler_use: compile_graphics_v1 requires occlusion probability above policy threshold before front evidence becomes an order edge
occlusion_probability.runtime_materialization: accepted evidence is compiled into order_edges
occlusion_probability.behavioral_path: accepted order edges control native pixel layer order
limitations: occlusion probability is a compiler gate; the raw value is not serialized to native runtime

visibility_probability_a_b.compiler_use: compile_graphics_v1 aggregates per-face probabilities to visible_fragment_ids
visibility_probability_a_b.behavioral_path: native renderer calls face_visible and skips invisible faces before rasterization
visibility_probability_a_b.behavioral_test: tests/compiler/test_vnext_graphics_native_e2e.py proves graphics.bin visibility alone changes final native RGBA from visible pixels to zero alpha

attachment_affinity.compiler_use: compile_graphics_v1 combines attachment affinity with mechanical persistent_contact and emits GraphicsAttachmentV1
attachment_affinity.runtime_materialization: attachments are carried into RuntimeGraphicsV1 and graphics.bin
attachment_affinity.behavioral_debt: native reference graphics renderer parses attachments but does not use them in raster/playback behavior
attachment_affinity.required_next: identify and test the owning attachment/motion consumer or keep attachment explicitly non-behavioral in runtime claims

fragment_support_band_pixels.producer: compile_graphics_v1 derives support band from alpha-boundary evidence
fragment_support_band_pixels.runtime_materialization: RuntimeGraphicsV1 and graphics.bin carry the integer support band
fragment_support_band_pixels.behavioral_debt: graphics_v1.hpp parses/validates it but runtime_v2_graphics_reference.cpp does not apply it
fragment_support_band_pixels.required_next: wire an explicitly authorized 2D support consumer or remove support-band behavior from claims

behavioral_tests.proves: explicit graph precedence overrides contradictory physical depth in native ordering
serialized graphics visibility content changes final native raster output

next_actions: wire Graphics Truth V2 producers with authority/provenance/validity and corpus statistics
add behavior court for fragment changes caused by same/cut/boundary decisions
resolve or remove support-band behavioral claims
re-run this lineage after each producer/compiler/runtime schema change
